title: Normalized isomorphism inverse transport at a single finite coefficient field
statement: Let l be a prime, E/Q_l a finite extension, g:X→Y an isomorphism of schemes with l invertible in the residue fields, and hX,hY proofs that l is a unit in the stalks. Then the single-field normalized transport package IsomorphismFieldTransportStage(l,E,g,hX,hY) of [def-pod-isomorphism-field-transport-clauses] is inhabited. This asserts the completed-module, integral and raw rational inverse equivalences, their additive/exact/linear and normalized shift properties, and precisely the lambda and epsilon component formulas. It does not compare different coefficient fields and does not assert any common-stage descent.

proof.text: Use the completed coefficient limit-lift projection equation. The section-normalized module counits for g and inv g give both inverse-composition isomorphisms, hence an equivalence. Exactness and additivity are the sectionwise module inverse-image instances.

source.place: First paragraph, inverse automorphism squares and “Since g* is an equivalence”; expanded steps of lem-pod-isomorphism-field-transport.

proof.text: Apply normalized raw-stage exactness to g and inv g. Invert its kappa-normalized comparison to obtain lambda with its shift compatibility. Compose lambda_inv, inverse image of lambda_g, and the section-normalized derived counit; restrict this natural isomorphism through the full subcategory inclusion. Its component equals the prescribed epsilon by the lambda normalization. Exchange g and inv g for the other counit, hence obtain the integral equivalence. Retain the raw-stage linearity and exactness.

proof.text: Extend the two additive linear integral functors by raw scalar localization with the identity coefficient map. The coefficient-map uniqueness makes that map the identity; the tensor formulas identify the extensions with the prescribed rational pullbacks by uniqueness. Localize the integral counit components. Naturality on arbitrary tensor Hom arrows follows from the generic transformation extension, and extension_comp identifies its source with the composite extensions. Both localized counits give the rational equivalence. The raw-stage theorem supplies the normalized rational shift and exactness.
